subject: Post-discovery: propose 30m intro windows + ops / security attendee
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: propose 30m intro windows + ops / security attendee

Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the open conversation about latency/cost targets and the multi-tenant constraints you flagged. Quick recap and a short ask to lock next steps:

- Recap: You’re evaluating inference options for the recommendation pipeline (500–800 concurrent users peak), priority is sub-150ms p50 token latency and solid audit logging for PCI scope.
- Questions we promised to follow up on: (1) retention policy examples for logs, (2) dedicated pool sizing estimate — Mina will send those notes after this thread.

Next step: a 30-minute product intro + ops/security sync where we walk the runtime architecture, demo a 2-minute cold-start profile, and surface the audit/retention controls that map to your requirements. Can you pick one of these windows (all times PT):

1) Tue Jun 6, 11:00–11:30 AM PT — compact walkthrough + Q&A
2) Wed Jun 7, 9:00–9:30 AM PT — deeper infra focus (ops recommended)
3) Thu Jun 8, 3:30–4:00 PM PT — flexible if you need to include an exec

If none work, feel free to propose 2–3 slots and I’ll coordinate. Also: please let us know who from your side should join for security/infra (we suggest product lead + security/compliance contact).

I’ve attached a one-pager that highlights the runtime and SLA options — Mina will follow with sizing estimates once we lock time.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0136

Attachment: RDW-CloudNova-30m-briefing-onepager.pdf (PDF)
From: Alex Chen <alex@cloudnova.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@cloudnova.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: propose 30m intro windows + ops / security attendee

Thanks, Dylan — appreciated the recap.

Quick answers: 11:00 AM PT on Tue Jun 6 works best for our team. I’ll be joined by Sasha (security lead) — copying her here. If you could add whoever from infra/ops will speak to pooling and sizing that’d be great (Marissa / Mina?).

Also: two asks before the call if possible —
- Can you attach a short example of an audit log export (fields + retention options)?
- Any notes on default encryption-at-rest behavior and KMS integration flow?

We’re targeting an internal readiness check with senior infra on Jun 14, so the June 6 slot gives us time to surface any blockers beforehand.

Appreciate the quick turnaround,
Alex
Principal Engineering Manager | CloudNova
alex@cloudnova.com

Perfect — thanks Alex and Sasha.

We’re locked for: Tue Jun 6, 11:00–11:30 AM PT. I’ll send a calendar invite that includes a short agenda: 1) 5-minute recap, 2) 12-minute demo (runtime + cold-start), 3) 10-minute ops/security Q&A, 4) next steps / mutual action items.

Marissa will own the demo and Mina will bring the sizing and audit/export examples you requested (I’ve attached the Intro_Deck.pdf that has a short KMS & encryption summary on slide 6).

Action items:
- Dylan: create invite + share mutual action plan link (done)
- Mina: send log export examples + sizing note by end of day Mon Jun 5
- Alex/Sasha: add any specific security controls you want covered in the agenda
